findings.quote: its pinned round-13 bytes are read from `4acc607` through `.ufo/evidence/round-18/dispositions.json`
findings.why: At C0 the row's own tool contains no reference to dispositions, 4acc607 or round 13 (grep -c gives 0/0/0 in tools/bash-witness-study.py); it parses PIN_BASH/REV_BASH from tools/mutate-and-run.sh:616-617 (275d8294…/fecee874…), while 4acc607 exists only as the historical_inputs rev for that tool inside .ufo/evidence/round-18/dispositions.json, a file read by the evidence-disposition gate, so the cell attributes to this tool a read another program performs.

Two of these anchors resolve (QUALITY criteria 37-39 at corpus/QUALITY.md:334/344/352, S049 at corpus/SOURCES.md:58) but the third is the run-together ASCII token lessonround19 (xxd: 6c6573736f6e726f756e643139), which is neither a path nor an evidence id — the lesson file is corpus/lessons/round-19.md and git grep finds no lessonround19 anywhere under corpus/ — so a cold reader cannot resolve that citation.
